companyName: Gordon and Leslie Diamond Health Care Centre

sources.label: Infrastructure BC Schedule 9
sources.note: The one-page executed schedule directly identifies AHV Access Health Vancouver Ltd., incorporation date 2004-07-19, number BC0700111 and British Columbia jurisdiction. It records ABN AMRO Bank N.V. as holder of all 1,000 issued common shares at the original contract date. It is historical identity and financial-close evidence, not a current register.

sources.label: Infrastructure BC Project Agreement
sources.note: The 59-page severed agreement directly names Vancouver Coastal Health Authority and AHV Access Health Vancouver Ltd. as Project Co. It identifies PCL Constructors Westcoast Inc. as prime contractor, Brookfield LePage Johnson Controls Facility Management Services as original services contractor, and contains ProjectCo change-in-control consent provisions. It does not disclose the cutoff-current shareholding chain.

sources.label: VCH FY2025/26 Financial Statements
sources.note: The browser loaded and downloaded the current 39-page audited statements despite a CloudFront block on the raw fetch. Extracted text states that VCHA has a 30-year Gordon and Leslie Diamond Health Care Centre contract with Access Health Vancouver Ltd. to August 2036, and that AHV designed, constructed, financed and will maintain the facilities through that term. This is current counterparty and operating-role evidence, not equity evidence.

sources.label: JLIF 2017 Annual Report
sources.note: The direct issuer-report wrapper lists Vancouver General Hospital, Canada at 100% in the portfolio and reports 100.0% equity and subordinated-loan-stock holding at 2017-12-31. This is the last located AHV-project-specific percentage, but it is historical investment reporting rather than a current corporate register or voting schedule.

sources.label: Jura/JLIF Scheme RNS
sources.note: The rendered issuer-release republication was independently reopened. It says Jura Acquisition Limited was a newly formed company owned by a consortium jointly led by funds managed by Dalmore Capital Limited and funds managed by Equitix Investment Management Limited, and that its acquisition of all JLIF shares became effective on 2018-09-28. It does not allocate AHV-level ownership.

sources.label: KED Jura Sell-down
sources.note: The current article says Dalmore and Equitix sold down interests in the Jura/JLIF portfolio and that South Korean investors received interests in 36 of 67 assets after a reshuffling that increased Canadian exposure. It supplies no asset schedule and neither names nor excludes AHV.

sources.label: Royal London Dalmore Completion
sources.note: Royal London's direct 2025-11-03 release says ownership of Dalmore Capital and its asset-servicing arm Resolis transferred to Royal London Asset Management and that both continue as standalone businesses. It describes a manager and servicing-business acquisition, not an AHV ProjectCo share transfer or cap table.

sources.label: Investment Canada Case 00037453
sources.note: The direct federal case page names Royal London Asset Management Holdings Limited as investor and AHV Access Health Vancouver Ltd. twice among the investees, with a 2025-12-04 publication date and United Kingdom country of ultimate control. It does not identify any AHV shareholder, intermediate ownership chain, fund, vehicle, percentage or project-level effective date.

conclusion: Fresh direct evidence verifies AHV Access Health Vancouver Ltd. as the PPP ProjectCo, its original ABN AMRO share record, continued 2026 counterparty and maintenance role, JLIF's historical 100% project holding, the 2018 Jura parent take-private, the unscheduled 2019 portfolio sell-down, and the 2025 Royal London manager transaction and Investment Canada notice. It still does not identify whether AHV was included in the 2019 sell-down or disclose the cutoff-current direct or indirect AHV shareholders, managers, funds, vehicles, stakes and effective dates.
